//: Budgets for what a visitor downloads. Enforced by the Perf workflow.
//mustStayLazy: Packages that must not appear in any route's static closure. Each was
deliberately moved to a dynamic import; a single value import in a shared
module puts one straight back on the critical path of every route that
touches that module, and nothing else in CI would notice. @atproto/api
and the packages it drags in were 221 KB gzipped on all 32 routes.
Raising a name out of this list is a decision, not a fix.
dompurify and html2canvas were already loaded dynamically before any of
this, and nothing was stopping that from being undone. sanitize.ts loads
DOMPurify on demand and preloads it from the layout -- the same shape the
AT Protocol SDK now uses -- and falls back to stripping all tags until it
arrives, so making it static would look harmless and cost every visitor
//maxRouteGzip: Ceiling on one route's download over the entry, in bytes. The heaviest
route measured 71 KB when this was set; the headroom is for ordinary
growth, not for a dependency returning to the critical path, which the
list above catches on its own.
//maxEntryGzip: Ceiling on the entry every visitor pays before anything renders.
Measured at 66.3 KB when this was set.
